info.name: Abakus API v1
info.description:
Full test suite for the Abakus API (Obligatorio 1, Desarrollo Full Stack, ORT).

Run the whole collection, in order, with the Collection Runner. Every run creates its own advisors and data (request 0.1 generates a unique run_id), so it can be run again.

prod_base_url points to the API published on Vercel. To run it locally, override prod_base_url with http://localhost:3000 (for example in an environment).

Requires the preloaded admin (scripts/seed-admins.js) whose credentials are admin_username / admin_password.
Request 11.2 uploads fixtures/abakus-logo.png: in Newman run from documentation/postman; in Postman pick the file again if it is not found.
